framework: Autonomous-readiness criteria for SDL instrument interfaces

notes.C1: Native SiLA 2 server; reconnect documented only as “best-effort”; mode and operation-identifier mechanism must be specified explicitly.
notes.C2: Typed parameters; units from declared vocabulary; FDL constraints machine-readable and enforced.
notes.C3: SiLA 2 defined errors with stable ID, message, structured context, device timestamp; errors retrievable after delivery.
notes.C4: No paywall; ecosystem-use licence; publication and reuse of buyer-written code permitted.
notes.C5: Headless retrieval by execution ID; HDF5 payload readable without vendor software.
notes.C6: FDL exposes capability introspection (a); operations not scoped to deployed module configuration (b absent).
notes.C7: Kinetic acquisition observable; concurrent status query returns within documented interval.
notes.C9: LockController exposes lock state; ownership reporting, preemption path and hierarchical locks not documented.
notes.C10: Named operational states with documented recovery transitions.
notes.C11: Stable result IDs; no in-flight access to increments during the run.
notes.C12: Calibration, qualification and usage state not exposed through the API.
notes.C13: Semver plus deprecation notices; research-only context; regulated bar not evaluated.
notes.C14: Drop-in simulator fails on invalid inputs but has no configurable failure injection.
notes.C15: Exposes control-session-lost status with a configurable, overridable safe default.
notes.C16: No recovery taxonomy beyond identifier and message.
notes.C17: SiLA 2 self-certification with complete test evidence and versioned Feature set.
notes.C18: Native SiLA 2 network service, reachable from any client OS.
notes.C19: Motorized carrier supports automated load/unload; no explicit handoff-ready signal.
notes.C20: Door state and axis motion exposed; no declared robot-access state.
notes.C21: Orchestrator shutdown (b) supported; hardware safety-event reporting (a) absent.

C1.commitment: Specify reconnect mode and operation-identifier mechanism. Target: 6 months.

C12.commitment: Expose calibration, qualification and usage state through the API. Target: 9 months.

C16.commitment: Expose recovery taxonomy fields on error classes. Target: 9 months.

C19.commitment: Documented handoff-ready signal before unmanned cell operation.

C21.commitment: Hardware safety-event reporting before unmanned cell operation.

reasons.text: Critical Partial on C1 accepted with a dated remediation commitment.
